candidate: Consolidate three GameMode lookup and cast pairs into one per original NPC Tick, preserving all ordered Sequence branches and per-frame behavior
baseline: Published original Content, three independent editor runs per NPC count at 5, 20 and 50, fixed 1280x720 D3D12 viewport, 10-second warmup and 15-second capture
primary_metric: Median of three run medians for the actual PIE world actor-tick span at 50 NPCs, including all world actors rather than isolated NPC CPU time
early_stop: Measure three 50-NPC candidate runs first. If the primary median reduction is below 5 percent, decline adoption and stop this experiment
adoption_gate: At least 5 percent lower primary median, all functional contracts unchanged or corrected, then no greater than 5 percent regression in median-of-run-p95 world actor-tick spans at 5 or 20 NPCs
non_claims: This is a bounded single-machine engineering screen, not statistical significance or a general FPS guarantee. Raw timings and run variation remain available
preservation: Keep the initial asset and experiment results. A declined candidate remains inspectable source tooling and is excluded from the final playable asset
